name: get_entities
author: hprebar
title: Find entities
description: Selects entities by DXF type (LINE, LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, INSERT, TEXT, MTEXT, DIMENSION, HATCH…) and/or layer, in model space or the current space, and returns handle, type, layer and bounding box in millimetres for up to limit of them. Read-only.

type.description: DXF entity name such as LINE, LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, INSERT, TEXT, MTEXT, DIMENSION; omit for any type

layer.description: Exact layer name; omit for any layer

space.description: model (default), current (the active layout), or all
